text: Illustrate the story here: Slugs on a Plant Glen and Al are slugs. Glen and Al are pals. Al can not run. Glen can not trot. Glen and Al are not fast. Al is glum. "Slugs can not do a lot," Al said. "Slugs can rest!" Glen said. Glen and Al plop on top of a plant. Slugs are the best at rest. Al is glad. Glen and Al nap on the plant.
